tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: 82.3 HFCs shall provide information on interest rates, information on interest common fees and charges (including penal charges, rates, common fees and if any) through putting up notices in their branches; charges (including penal through telephone or help-lines; on the company’s interest, if any) through website; through designated staff/ help desk; or putting up notices in their providing service guide/ tariff schedule.
